mapper.select: select * from Investment_Budget_Breakdown_change where Project_ID = #{projectId} and state!=3

select ibb.*,pro.P_Name as projectName, pro.P_Construction_Unit as projectConstructionUnit,sd.D_Name as projectConstructionUnitName, pro.P_Apply_File as projectApplyFile, pro.P_Approve_budget as pApproveBudget, pro.p_record_amount as pRecordAmount, pro.p_approval_amount as pApprovalAmount, pro.p_project_form_type as pProjectFormType, pro.p_inv_total as pInvTotal from Investment_Budget_Breakdown_change ibb left join Pre_Project pro on ibb.Project_ID = pro.P_ID left join SYS_Department sd on pro.P_Construction_Unit = sd.D_ID where ibb.id = #{id}
